name: Case file row links the download and shows the start of its SHA-256 (signed in)
description: Validates the case file row in Evidence mode: it links /cases/eagle-s-2024/case-file as a download named cabletrace-eagle-s-2024.json, and the 12 characters it shows are the start of the full SHA-256 in its tooltip. The downloaded file itself is checked by scripts/cases/verify-case-file.ts, which recomputes the hash.

planSteps.description: In the sign-in form (data-testid account-form), type testsprite@example.com in the Email field and cabletrace-testsprite-2026 in the Password field, then click Sign in
Wait up to 30 seconds until the URL is no longer under /sign-in
Navigate to /cases/eagle-s-2024?mode=evidence and wait up to 60 seconds for the 3D view (data-testid seabed-view) to reach data-state "ready"
Assert the "Case file" row (data-testid download-case-file) is a link with href "/cases/eagle-s-2024/case-file" and a download attribute "cabletrace-eagle-s-2024.json"

Assert the row shows a 12 character lowercase hexadecimal hash in a small span element inside the link; the title attribute sits on that span (not on the link) and reads "SHA-256 " followed by 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters that start with the 12 shown
Assert the row reads "Case file" and "JSON with every position, quote and source"
